items.title: European orbiter detects fresh hints of volcanic activity on Mars
items.summary: New evidence from gas seeping above volcanic rifts suggests Mars is not geologically dead deep inside, but merely sleeping. Fresh fissures along the Alba Mons region hint at active spots under the surface, where gases from inside the planet may be making their way up to the surface.

items.title: Flat feet may have helped Neanderthals stay stable while carrying heavy loads
